question: Omuhendo gwahaansi aha mirimo y'okwohereza enyehurira z'obwengye niguha abaana omugisha murungi okukuza obuhangwa?
answer_a: Okushushaniisa ekishushani ky'omuringo gw'ekiteeteeyi (mandala) orikukoresa amarangi g'amaizi
answer_b: Okukata ebishushani norikukoresa amapapura agariyoona gariyoona
answer_c: Okukora omuti ogurikureebwa kuruga omu rurembo orurikumarirwamu orutindo norukoresa ebumba
answer_d: Okuteiba empapura z'amara omu miringo etari emwe emwe

question:
Omu mwaka gutandika, abeeshure omu ishomero nibashabwa kuhayo orubazo rw'edakiika 2 aha bi baakozire omu bwiire bw'ekyanda. Paula, omwishiki orikusonya n'okuceeceera, naateegyereza omurundi gwe okugamba. Ku arikukora eki, omutima gwe gutandika kukuba munoonga, ebiganja bye bitandika kubira enjoka n'enda ye neegwa omu kantu. Omwegyesa we ku amwetera omu maisho Paula yaatandika kugamba, agumirwa kwijuka eki arikwenda kugamba n'engaro ze zaatandika kutentema.

Omu mbeera eyo, niki ekirikubaasa kuteebwa kurungi kuruga aha nshemeziro za Paula n'emitwarize ye?
answer_a: Omutima gwe nigwo gukora nk'eky'okucungira nigwo guri haihi.
answer_c: Aineenyerwa kugaamba aha biro by'oruhooro rwe.
answer_d: Obwahati ashangire kuba aine ekizibu ekirikumutwara.

question: Okurikugyenderwaho eky'omugambi gwa Bowlby, ni ndyahi aha bigambo ebi erikuhikaana n'ekirikworeka omutwarize gw'okugyenderaana?
answer_a: N'omuringo ogurikumara okuhitsya omu myaka y'obuto bw'omuntu
answer_b: Ni omukago ogushemereire kuguma guriho kandi ogutahwamu, kubaasa kuhwera omwana kukura omu muringo oguhikire.
answer_c: Omugashani nigwo gurikushobora kumanya omukago gwona ogurikukwata aha mukura gw'obwomeezi n'enkura y'omuntu.
answer_d: Buhikye bwa iraangiro obw'omwana omuhya n'omunyeeneka we kandi tiburikubaasa kutaangwa omuntu ondiijo
